name: Jefferson Valley Mall
summary: Jefferson Valley Mall is Yorktown Heights' premier shopping destination featuring market-exclusive brands, locally-owned specialty shops, and diverse dining options. The mall serves as a community hub, hosting over 10 annual events including seasonal festivals, car shows, and family-friendly celebrations throughout the year.
demographics: Jefferson Valley Mall serves the affluent northern Westchester County market, attracting primarily middle to upper-middle income families from Yorktown Heights and surrounding communities. The trade area includes a mix of suburban households with above-average incomes, professional workers commuting to nearby corporate centers, and retirees. Shoppers tend to be value-conscious yet quality-focused, seeking a convenient local alternative to larger metropolitan shopping destinations, with strong preferences for both national retailers and locally-owned specialty shops.
description: Jefferson Valley Mall stands as Yorktown Heights' premier shopping destination, serving the northern Westchester County community with a carefully curated mix of market-exclusive brands and locally-owned specialty shops. Located at 650 Lee Boulevard, this regional mall has established itself as more than just a retail center—it's a community gathering place that brings together shopping, dining, and entertainment experiences under one roof. The mall distinguishes itself through an active events calendar, hosting more than 10 signature events annually including the Hudson Valley Gateway Chamber of Commerce Spring Festival and Car Show, Christmas in July celebrations, Fall Festival & Car Show, Boo N Brew, and beloved seasonal traditions like Photos with the Easter Bunny and Santa. With convenient hours throughout the week and a strong commitment to serving both residents and tourists alike, Jefferson Valley Mall offers a welcoming atmosphere where visitors can discover everything from everyday essentials to unique specialty items. The center's blend of national retailers and local merchants creates a distinctive shopping experience that reflects the character of the Yorktown Heights community.
